header.title: China localization of chips, tools and materials lifts domestic industrial-resilience suppliers

s01_bottom_line.text: Industry 5.0's resilience pillar aims to reduce reliance on foreign technology by developing advanced chips, software, machine tools and materials, a localization share shift toward Chinese suppliers.
The article frames self-sufficiency in critical technologies as a core, long-term pillar of the investment opportunity.

Domestic Chinese semiconductor, equipment, machine-tool and materials makers could gain share as localization proceeds, but the article names no companies and quantifies no supplier-level revenue effect.
